what.text: This page follows refugees from Namibia in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 685 Namibian refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 75.5% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Canada, Sweden and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Namibia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1979 to 1988.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1966 at 180 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 77550, at the end of 1984.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
